runtimeBoundary: Android API37 instrumentation launches DomainActivity, observes its Activity-owned DomainPageOwner, injects only external service leaves, invokes production events, and captures before/after state and emitted navigation/service effects.
baseBoundary: The base keeps the 23.6 partial domains list behavior but lacks wired search entry, retry, title filtering, remote suggestion debounce, proposal purchase routing, cart recovery, typed checkout completion, and contained URL rejection.
finalBoundary: The final implements the complete 23.7 All Domains management and purchase lifecycle without testcase identifiers or evaluator access.
